text:
tara.pm: hi all, first day! quick asks: need Figma (Redwood org + Tokens file), access to Product Roadmap Q3, and Research Drive. also curious if we have an accessibility checklist for new designs?

yen.designops: welcome @tara :tada: i'll invite you to the Figma org and design google group. use tara@redwood.com? i'll also add you to the Product Roadmap page after you submit the access form.

tara.pm: yes tara@redwood.com. thanks! about a11y checklist 2 is there a short runnable checklist we follow for prototypes?

cal.design: hey @tara 2 welcome! we keep a lightweight a11y checklist in Notion (Design > Accessibility) 2 includes color contrast, keyboard nav, focus order, and screen-reader labels. For prototypes we run axe-core locally and do one paired screen-reader check.

leo.research: tagging on research ops: i'll add you to the Research Drive and the participant tracker. we try to include 10% participants from assistive-tech users for checkout flows once we hit external testing. happy to pair if you want to recruit for accessibility tests.

figma-bot: Invitation sent to tara@redwood.com for Redwood Figma org.

yen.designops: sent invites for Figma and Google group. Notion invite pending via product access form.

tara.pm: got the Figma invite, can see Tokens file but no edit rights on the Checkout tokens page.

infra-bot: To request edit access, file a ticket in #eng-requests with subject `access: figma-edit` and include file name `Tokens 2 v2` and your email. Add @yen.designops to escalate.

yen.designops: i've requested edit permission on your behalf; in meantime duplicate the Tokens page for a local copy. also FYI we're migrating tokens next sprint 2 if you plan component work, ping me so we can coordinate renames.

tara.pm: great, i'll duplicate for now and schedule a short sync about the tokens migration. leo, i'd love to pair on an a11y research session this week 2 when are you free to shadow?

leo.research: i have a 1pm slot Thurs for an internal accessibility observation 2 i'll add you. also pasted the quick recruitment flow in the Research folder (internal vs external flags).

tara.pm: perfect, thanks everyone! one last thing: any must-dos for week 1 beyond these accesses?

cal.design: short week-1 list: accept invites, enable Redwood UI & Tokens libraries, join Tue design crit, read Product > Roadmap > Q3 summary, shadow one research session, and file any staging access tickets.

tara.pm: copying checklist now 2 appreciate the warm welcome :heart:
